reason: My bookkeeper already collects everything from the group once a month and sorts it out, and I almost never look at receipts myself. This fixes a problem I've already paid someone else to handle.
objection: Will a small new bot still be around in a year? I don't want my bookkeeper's whole process built around something that disappears, and I don't really want another tool reading our work chats.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me this saves them real hours and cuts their monthly fee, with the Google Sheet staying ours if Nota shuts down.
